notes.title: Untravelled Planet RELEASES TODAY! 📢
notes.content:
Untravelled Planet is finally ready for release, coming today to Steam! Thank you for all your support over development, It's time for you to explore planet F33-4 untraveled areas.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45339169/14c4125128a1392d548cc8a09ffe3dac94ab245d.png[/img]


Since the game is developed by a small team of three developers, it is expected that there may be some bugs that we have missed. We hope you understand this and report any bugs to the development team email.

[url=yaqutgames@gmail.com]Contact email[/url]


- Yaqut Games
